title: The Ruined Chapel
intro: Rain falls through a broken roof onto pews that have not held a congregation in centuries. The altar's reliquary is the next lock.

objects.label: Confessional
objects.reward_text: The confessional door bursts open. Something was listening.

objects.label: Prayer Book
objects.reward_text: The spirit is amused. It whispers: 'Everything in this room is connected. Finish what you started.'

a_glass: Write the rule as a formula: next = previous + the one before that + a fixed extra.
Check it: 3 + 2 + 1 = 6. Keep going one generation at a time.
Generation 10 = 114 + 70 + 1 = 185. The vault's character number 1 is K.
b_bell: Start with the clue that rules out the most positions, such as a figure at an end.
Work out which figures are certainly NOT next to each other, then try the possible arrangements.
From the left, the order begins: Maid, Baron.
The full row from the left is: Maid, Baron, Duke, Heir, Priest, Doctor. The answer is the Heir. The vault's character number 2 is 5.
c_candles: Look up P and Q in your clue notes.
List the numbers above 47 that leave remainder 4 when divided by P.
Check each of them against the second condition (remainder 1 when divided by Q).
The answer is 49. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are H and K.
dare_book: A dare is optional and never needed to leave the floor.
It never costs you anything to skip it.
Do the dare only if you and your team are happy with it.
It never owns part of the vault code. Skip it freely.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Stained Glass, Church Bell, Altar Candles.
